title: VerusEval: Evaluating LLM-Generated Verus Specifications Beyond Verifier Acceptance

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating 13,716 artifacts from four workflows, five LLMs, and two prompting settings on 762 tasks, we find that acceptance overstates quality: only 42.3\% of the accepted artifacts complete all three semantic checks without a flag, and across workflows and models, higher acceptance does not consistently come with more correct contracts.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Assessing specification generation therefore requires an evaluation methodology, not a single metric.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Of the accepted artifacts flagged by contract comparison, 84.1\% have a rejected completeness obligation, and the direction of a failure prioritizes inspection of the generated contract or the reference; it does not by itself establish which artifact is defective.
